data.rationale: The proposal follows the same Booking → Xe → Mail sequence and gets the subject and body templates right. It misses the review-score ≥ 8 criterion, the "do not Reserve" constraint, and the fixed recipient form {traveler}@example.com. It also lists hotel name, price and converted amount as parameters when they are outputs. Its "top or chosen hotel", "receiving amount" and "Discard or send" wording is ambiguous or risky, since the true workflow never sends, so an automation would need guesswork.
